documented-approval.reason: The documented approval meets this compliance requirement.

denied.reason: The authorization record contains an explicit refusal.

inspection-failed.reason: The reviewer records an inspection failure.

insufficient-evidence.reason: The reviewer saw insufficient evidence to decide.

explicit-pending.reason: The reviewer explicitly reports that the review has yet to occur.

excluded.reason: The target is outside the approval requirement.

remaining_cases.unanswered: Needs a fixture that distinguishes no submitted response from an explicitly selected pending response.
remaining_cases.stale: Needs an answer artifact bound to a prior Assessment revision.
remaining_cases.migration: Needs source-backed OCIL response translation and an independent equivalence receipt.
